summary: Colin Drew Sutton, 38, Wolf Creek Ski Area avalanche technician and senior patroller, was caught in an avalanche ~1:30 p.m. Tuesday during a helicopter-accessed exploration and research mission on Conejos Peak (~20 mi east of Wolf Creek); dug out immediately by his partner and two other emergency personnel, airlifted by Medevac helicopter to Mercy Regional Hospital in Durango, pronounced deceased 4:30 p.m.
responding_agency: Wolf Creek Ski Patrol / emergency personnel
notes: Incident-focused. Sutton was a 12-yr full-time Wolf Creek patroller, NSP member, EMT, Certified Level III Avalanche Technician, snow study director, C-RAD dog handler (black lab Boca). OSHA fined Wolf Creek 4,000, finding inadequate communication with patrol HQ while outside the area boundary. USFS charged owner Randall Davey Pitcher with 5 misdemeanors (unauthorized avalanche training on public land + unauthorized explosives use); Pitcher pleaded guilty to one charge of conducting SAR training on public land without a permit, sentenced to 5 yrs supervised probation, 500 hrs SAR-related community service, ,000 fine (federal magistrate, ~Dec 2014). County from reverse-geocode of Conejos Peak (Conejos Co). Second Wolf Creek patroller avalanche fatality since Nov 2010; the 2010-11-22 inbounds patrol-director Scott Kay fatality was ski-patrol-only, excluded per convention. Merged 2026-09-18 (run 888): Unofficial Networks 2014-09-19 follow-up — Wolf Creek owner Davey Pitcher faced federal misdemeanor charges; embeds the full CAIC report (HS-ASu-R3-D3, 250-ft crown, ~30-min burial, Flight for Life to Durango).
